criterion: Open the GIS module from the V4 launcher; the GIS workspace loads with the map and its available controls visible.
steps_taken: Clicked the GIS module Open module button
Verified GIS, map, layer controls, search, and zoom controls were visible
reason: Direct UI evidence confirms the GIS workspace loaded from the launcher.

criterion: Use the map search to find a known site or location; the map moves to the selected result and shows it as the active location.
steps_taken: Selected the visible London UK result
Verified the map moved to London and a map marker appeared
reason: Direct UI evidence confirms the selected London result repositioned the map and created an active marker.

criterion: Select the visible map marker itself; a details panel opens for the same location and shows its identifying information.
steps_taken: Clicked the visible map marker at the selected London location
Waited for the UI to update
Verified no details panel or identifying information appeared
reason: Direct contradictory evidence: the visible marker remained and no details panel opened after the marker click.

criterion: Close the details panel and return to the map; the map remains at the selected location and the GIS controls remain usable.
steps_taken: Attempted the marker interaction required to produce the details panel
Observed that no details panel opened
Cleared the map search and navigated back to the launcher to restore state
reason: Testing occurred, but the required details panel was not created, so its close-and-return journey could not be evaluated.
